summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, checks for a local `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it via `execFileSync` to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with hex-mangled identifiers, a rotated string/opcode table, and an array-shift decoder (`function WV8StW(...) {... MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift());... }`). The payload is executable only under Bun, which prevents Node-based inspection, and has no source-side counterpart under `src/`. The declared purpose of the package is an ESLint plugin for folder schema, which has no need to fetch a full JavaScript runtime or execute an opaque compiled bundle at install time. The alternate-runtime dropper shape (fetch a non-Node runtime, use it to execute a shipped obfuscated blob at install) auto-executes on `npm install` and delivers attacker-controlled code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
